logistics.format: Multiple-choice, in-person Pearson VUE or remote-proctored

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded accreditation, technical privacy coverage and a three-year profile support professional privacy-engineering decisions; relative novelty and a knowledge exam constrain claims of established expert implementation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation, technical privacy focus and a three-year profile support professional privacy-solutions judgment. The multiple-choice assessment leaves practical engineering unproven, and the record distinguishes it from stronger legal-focused signals.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded technical privacy focus is relevant to secure systems, but the examination is multiple choice without documented implementation tasks. I therefore discount the professional hints to associate engineering knowledge despite the three-year profile.
